summary: Senior Product Manager with a track record of owning complex products end to end and using data to drive measurable outcomes, from cutting settlement failures by 34% on the Faster Payments integration at Starling Bank to reducing chargeback disputes by 18% at Revolut. Experienced leading cross-functional teams of engineers and designers to align stakeholders and deliver reliable, well-run systems at scale.

bullets: Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers
Directed hiring for the payments team
